svg.title: Kairos approved cobalt coral identity board
svg.desc: Approved Kairos identity: original A circular K with a coral opportunity point, cobalt primary ink. Exact colors: cobalt #203C86, porcelain #F4F5F1, coral #ED765D, mist #8AABE0. All artwork is vector geometry constructed and serialized in Krita. Includes positive, reversed, small and monochrome mark applications, wordmark, palette, and meaningful workflow illustration.
